entry_points.text: Central dispatch clears pending, marks in progress, runs per-CPU chain combining outcomes, records entropy and accounts spuriously unless debug-suppressed, releasing serialization across per-CPU execution.
Hotplug iterates active lines under raw lock notifying chips of online and offline CPUs when supported.

Debug decodes handler, status, data and affinity, printing only overlapping names with reporting and empty mask variants and tolerating missing chip, names or ops. Open binds to sequential output. Setup creates top, per-line and per-domain entries with skips, name caching, removal cleanup, empty variants and mapped file operations.

exports.text: Simple, level, edge and fast-EOI flows with ack, mask, dispatch and completion per trigger. Simple gates on power and actions with pending on resend need. Edge loops while pending and enabled. Fast-EOI masks oneshot and resends when pending survives.
Installs flow handler by number, chained handler with data, and chip plus handler plus name together, under scoped descriptor with bus or lock.

Manages domain device power references. Forwards ack, mask, EOI, lifecycle, affinity, type, wake, resources, state and redirect to parents with fallback to simpler ops. State and vcpu queries use nearest capable ancestor, reporting unsupported or invalid when absent. Chips are optional callback tables with hotplug and wake flags.

Migrates off departing CPUs holding descriptor lock, masking unmovable chips, reusing pending masks and retrying, restores managed affinities under sparse exclusion, composes MSI via nearest capable ancestor, and handles redirect by recording first CPU and reporting done. Migration may break affinity or shut down lines without targets.

Threaded request validates number, sharing, options and power, rejecting bad lines and combinations. Release unlinks by token, shuts down only when last handler leaves, quiesces threads, balances references, clears disable-unlazy and warns on misuse.

Nestable disable and enable use depth from zero with hardware on first transition; no-sync only updates depth. Sync waits for redirect, hard polling with locked recheck, and threaded zero-active. Injection uses hardware pending or guarded resend when not NMI and activated, else invalid.

hazards.text: Per-CPU without identifier dispatches without shared totals. Devid selects first affinity match else disables CPU with once-only log. Untracked bridges unlocked dispatch with in-progress and no statistics. All plus NMI avoid shared locks, needing single-action and concurrency tolerance.

Misroute is disabled under one fixup, runs for unhandled when enabled and for handled on irq zero or poll actions under stronger settings. One global scan at a time; nested fails. Success reduces unhandled tallies.
Parent helpers dereference links and chips without absent checks, requiring guaranteed depth and initialization.

invariants.text: Outcomes none, handled and wake-thread combine inclusively; beyond handled plus wakeup is bogus. Chains wake threads with routines, warn once when missing, record context only when threadable without exclusions, require disabled interrupts, hold serialization for reports, time handlers when enabled, and use test-set run state with active counting and oneshot ordering on non-reentrancy.

Poll recovery considers only enabled non per-CPU lines with shared non-timer first action and not in progress, marking poll in progress across repeated dispatch and flagging busy ones pending. Forced polling overrides enabled check.

Null install uses bad path. Chained install needs outer hardware, reapplies trigger, marks no probe request thread, attaches shared action with power and resend then updates validity, with empty build inert. Uninstall masks, disables, releases power and sets depth one. Chained means action equals distinguished object and non null. Proc valid only when not hidden or chained with action.
No-request, thread and probe setters only add bits. Clear-set is confined by modify mask. Status refresh updates no-balance, per-CPU and level flags, adopts trigger mask and refreshes proc validity.
Parent walk follows link in one build and ends in the other. Descriptor resource acquire and release are optional with absence as success.

Migration skips without chip or affinity setter and for per-CPU, unstarted or affinity-excluding lines. Pending moves clear when disjoint from online, else reusable. Online restore touches only managed lines including incoming CPU; single-target moves only under housekeeping isolation.
Removal power and proc handling has active and empty builds; active adjusts depths and removes proc dirs. Descriptor logging is rate-limited best effort with identity, depths and symbolic addresses.

locks.text: Ack-oriented fast-EOI checks eligibility, accounts, masks oneshot, acks then dispatches before conditional completion. Mask-oriented masks and acks first. Both hold raw lock over chip callbacks.

Bus lock and sync-unlock guards call chip only when implemented and drop across quiescence to avoid deadlock. Debug collection holds descriptor lock; domain enumeration holds mutex and per-line enumeration holds sparse exclusion.

state_machines.text: Accounting skips polled lines, validates outcomes, defers wakeup-only one event via bit thirty one, and updates tallies with misroute adjustment. Tenth-second window resets unhandled, one hundred thousand events evaluate, ninety nine thousand nine hundred triggers stuck disable in software and hardware with poll timer arming.
Completion runs only when enabled, masked and idle without oneshot activity, combining with re-enable when idle or completing alone when threaded work remains.
Pending moves complete through forced-move before migration reuses or clears them.

Devm request allocates bookkeeping, defaults names, uses threaded path, records line and token on success and reports detailed errors on failure. Match compares both values; release frees via stored pair.

structs.text: Observed state includes pending masks, data accessors, chip identity tolerating absence, domain hierarchy ending at top, and decoded data state.
Outcomes beyond handled plus wakeup are bogus. Status words render through mask-name decoding.

Bit records pair masks with names with stringify helper and inclusion guard. Devres holds line plus token. Debug uses irq areas, decimal per-line 0644 files, default domain 0444 view, and bounded writes that trigger injection on keyword with clean copy-fault and error propagation.
